newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up despite profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up despite profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Monday amid heavy buying of select blue chips that helped the index regain early losses on profit-taking ahead of settlement on Tuesday, dealers said.

They said the index dropped in early trade as major investors squared their positions ahead of settlement but soon retail investors and speculators entered the market attracted by low prices of some of the leading blue chips.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index surged 24.39 points, or 1.21 percent, to close at 2,035.96 at 0903 GMT. Gainers led losers 164 to 78.
Hub Power rose 2.30 rupees to 58.85 rupees but PTCL (A) dropped 0.25 to 42.85.
